title: The Maharashtra State Board of Nursing and Paramedical Education Act, 2013.
full_text: The Maharashtra State Board of Nursing and Paramedical Education Act, 2013. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 201323 Act Number: 23 Enactment Date: 2013-08-21 Act Year: 2013 Short Title: The Maharashtra State Board of Nursing and Paramedical Education Act, 2013. Long Title: An Act to provide for the establishment of a State Board to regulate matters pertaining to the Diploma Level Nursing and Paramedical Education in the State of Maharashtra and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
